dedupe_keys.name: godeeep hydro historical and projected power system ready hydropower data for the united states

description: GODEEEP-hydro gives monthly and weekly hydropower generation and generation constraints for 1,483 hydropower plants in the contiguous United States, ready for power system models. It was published by Cameron Bracken, Youngjun Son, Daniel Broman and Nathalie Voisin, with the method described in Bracken and co-authors (2025). It covers 1982 to 2019 and 2021 to 2099 under four warming scenarios (RCP4.5 and RCP8.5, each cooler and hotter), built from dynamically downscaled WRF meteorology at 1/8 degree, VIC runoff, mosartwmpy routing and water management, and a per-plant regression calibrated to HydroWIRES data. Ten Parquet files give per plant and period the energy target, hours, average, maximum and minimum power and average daily operational range, with a plant metadata table keyed by EIA plant code. Coverage is the US fleet at weekly and monthly steps. Files are one ZIP of about 953 MB on Zenodo (version 1.2.0, August 2026) under CC0 at no cost. Caveats: projections come from one modelling chain and a replicated historical period with warming signals. Simulation uses are production cost and capacity expansion modelling under climate change. Related records: data-wecc-ads-2034-hydropower and data-eia-2020-plant-wind-solar-hourly-profiles are related GODEEEP and PNNL data.
